[DQC.US.0245.10947] The statement 0000002 - Statement - Condensed Consolidated Balance Sheets (Unaudited) includes the axis ConsolidatedEntitiesAxis in its presentation relationships. The ConsolidatedEntitiesAxis is intended to be used in a consolidating schedule to disaggregate financial data for specific entities within a consolidated group. It should not be used to identify legal entities in the statement section of a filing.
The filer should use the LegalEntityAxis to identify legal entities in the statement section of the filing. If the ConsolidatedEntitiesAxis is being used with the member AffiliatedEntityMember to represent receivables from, or investments in, related parties, the RelatedAndNonrelatedPartiesAxis with the member AffiliatedEntityMember should be used instead.
